item.title: Confessional 1.36.0
item.description:
• Overviews link each statement to the meeting it came from
  • Projects simplified to four tabs: Overview, Meetings, Sources, Chat
  • Clearer privacy badges: recorded and transcribed on this Mac, and where the notes are written
  • Fewer, better connections in Analytics, each checked by AI
  • Setup asks whether you record meetings, podcasts or both

item.title: Confessional 1.35.1
item.description:
• Studio clips caption each speaker's name as they start talking (toggle: Name captions).
  • The weekly digest opens with 'Previously on…'.

item.title: Confessional 1.35.0
item.description:
• Quotes captioned like a reality-show confessional (Highlights, and a Line of the week on Home).
  • Briefs open with 'Previously on…'.
  • After a call: 'The booth is open'.

item.title: Confessional 1.34.0
item.description:
• Every project has its own icon (picked from its name, never repeated; click it on the project page to change).
  • Screenshots along a meeting's timeline: hover for a bigger one, click to play from there.

item.title: Confessional 1.33.0
item.description:
• New Calendar screen: any month, recorded meetings (click to open) and your calendar's events; plan a meeting (on your calendar or just here) and be asked to record it when it starts.
  • Confessional offer is a corner card; meeting details on one line when there's room; date tiles in Studio.

item.title: Confessional 1.32.0
item.description:
• Your notes, filled in: the summary starts with the notes you typed during the call, each completed with what was said.
  • A warmer look: paper background, serif titles, reading-width summaries and transcripts, date tiles on meeting cards, owner tags on action items, matching project buttons, card-style chat suggestions.
  • Fixes: empty 'Topics over time' chart in the first weeks; folder-named recordings get readable titles.

item.title: Confessional 1.31.1
item.description:
• Ask about this meeting: a question box under the summary and transcript.
  • Copy button for the summary.
  • One click to accept a speaker's suggested name.
  • Tidier meeting list (time only under Today/Yesterday).

item.title: Confessional 1.31.0
item.description:
• Screenshots of the whole screen or a video window are trimmed afterwards to the part that kept changing (the video or shared screen); originals kept, snapped ones untouched, meeting-window captures untouched.
  • New projects are offered ('Start a … project?') instead of being created automatically; meetings still go into a project that clearly fits.

item.title: Confessional 1.30.3
item.description:
• When you watch this Mac over Screen Sharing, the floating call controls (and live captions) now show there automatically; they stay out of screen shares on calls otherwise.
  • recording.json notes the Confessional version.

item.title: Confessional 1.30.2
item.description: • New: Settings → Recording → 'Show the call controls over Screen Sharing', for watching this Mac from another one (off by default, so the controls stay out of screen shares on calls).
